summary: Qualcomm announced Linux support for its Snapdragon X2 Series at Snapdragon Summit 2026. This expands the ecosystem for agentic AI PCs and Googlebook laptops powered by Snapdragon.
details: Qualcomm has officially announced that Linux support is coming to its Snapdragon X2 Series. This significant development was unveiled at the Snapdragon Summit 2026, marking a new era for the platform.

The announcement highlights a broader push for Snapdragon-powered devices, including agentic AI PCs and Googlebook laptops. These new devices, along with various partner devices, were also showcased at the summit.
caption:
Linux is officially coming to Snapdragon X2 Series chips!

Qualcomm has officially announced that Linux support is coming to its Snapdragon X2 Series. This significant development was unveiled at the Snapdragon Summit 2026, marking a new era for the platform.

The announcement highlights a broader push for Snapdragon-powered devices, including agentic AI PCs and Googlebook laptops. These new devices, along with various partner devices, were also showcased at the summit.
